label.Dosage and administration:
Directions shake well before using put 1 or 2 drops in the affected eye(s) as needed see side of carton for directions for use
Directions for use: Hold the bottle just below the cap and twist the cap to open. BEFORE FIRST USE , hold the bottle upside down and dispense one drop of product to discard. Shake the bottle downward to remove residual product (see picture). Place 1 or 2 drops in the affected eye(s) as needed and blink. After use, shake the bottle downward to remove residual product that may be left on the tip (see picture on side panel). Replace cap after use. Discard 30 days after opening.
